modalLead: Release notes that stopped appearing after an upgrade, the site's posts arriving two at a time instead of ten, and the settings that were still in English whatever language you had chosen.

items.text: An upgrade shows its release notes again. On some installs the window you are reading never opened by itself, however many versions went by — and nothing on any screen could switch it back on. It opens on the first visit after an upgrade, as it always should have.
Replay the welcome tour actually replays it. Under Behaviour → General, the button promised the tour and the tips would come back and only the tips did. The welcome card returns with it now.

All ten posts from nextdash.cc reach the overview. Two of them shared the page with the releases and the rest were only reachable through All news & features. The overview holds fourteen rows now and keeps ten for the site's posts, so a busy release week no longer pushes them off.

Depth and Backdrop speak your language. The two controls under Appearance and every choice in them — Flat, Soft, Rich, Dots, Grid, Lines, Hatch — were left in English on a Dutch, German or French dashboard. Along with Browse… beside the theme, the widget title field, and the message a source shows when it still needs a token.

A category spread across two columns looks like one. The line under its name stopped short of where the category actually ended, so a wide one read as a narrow one that happened to have a long title. It now runs the full width.
Right-clicking a category header keeps its menu. If anything was redrawing in the background at that moment, the menu closed itself under the pointer.
